headline: Operating profit rises, but a tax quirk widens the net loss
summary_short: Olin's Q2 2026 revenue was $1,741.9M, roughly flat y/y, and operating income rose 31.7% to $46.5M, but a $17.1M tax provision on just $3.8M of pretax income (a 450% effective rate) widened the net loss to $(13.3)M from $(1.3)M a year ago.
summary_long: Chlor Alkali Products and Vinyls segment income fell y/y as Freeport, TX VCM plant operating issues cut segment income $40.1M and pricing/volumes softened; Epoxy and Winchester both improved on higher pricing and volumes. Gross margin widened to 10% of sales from 8%. A $17.1M tax provision on just $3.8M of pretax income (450% effective rate, driven by prior-year tax items and a lower estimated annual rate) pushed the net loss to $13.3M from $1.3M a year ago. Cash fell to $177.4M; long-term debt rose to $3,029.1M. On June 15, 2026 Olin agreed to an all-stock merger of equals with Huntsman Corporation, expected to close in H1 2027; FY2026 guidance stays near $200M capex and a 20%-30% effective tax rate.

drivers.explanation: Company reported sequential improvement across all three segments versus a Q1 2026 hit by a Shintech litigation charge, despite global volatility.

Chlor Alkali Products and Vinyls sales fell $160.0M on lower volumes, partly offset by higher pricing; Epoxy rose $90.9M on higher volumes/pricing; Winchester rose $52.7M on higher ammunition and military project revenue.

Epoxy gross margin rose $39.6M on higher pricing/lower costs and Winchester rose $8.1M on pricing and volume, more than offsetting a $14.7M Chlor Alkali/Vinyls decline from Freeport VCM plant operating issues.
Gross margin gains flowed through despite S&A costs rising $7.5M y/y on unfavorable FX ($5.6M) and higher legal/settlement expenses ($2.1M), partly offset by lower stock-based compensation.
A $17.1M tax provision on only $3.8M of pretax income (450% effective rate) from prior-year tax positions and a lower estimated annual rate outweighed the operating improvement.
Tracks the net income decline; weighted-average diluted shares were little changed at 113.9M versus 114.9M a year ago.
